evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Directive to discard prior knowledge asserts self-origination over what the record holds — the speaker's own authority over the knowledge base.
Command to strip knowledge from the record is an autonomy move — self-originated control over what is retained and what is erased.
Declarative negation of a past calibration appeals to stability of the record — what was never done should not be treated as done.
